::: {#def-random-variable .theorem}
# Random variable

A measurable function $V:\Omega\to\mathcal{R}(V)$ on a probability space $(\Omega,\mathcal{A},P)$: a quantity $V(\omega)$ that takes a value for each element $\omega$ of the sample space and whose behaviour is described by the (unknown) law $P$. Its values may be scalars, vectors or matrices.
:::
